result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign or DocuSign**\. However, the best choice depends on how many contracts you send, how many employees need access, and whether you need more than just electronic signatures.

If I were choosing software for a small business in the UK, these would be my shortlist.

## Best e-signature software compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Simple and easy to use.
- Send contracts and collect signatures online.
- Good document tracking and templates.
- Integrates with Dropbox and other business tools.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![AlignedPartner - Partner Program Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6SBWynbkn-bwRkCuMIHuBO284Y100e0fDpdUDFLZztrUUgkyW1-tpHcC5kTOqtjz5KB_xBScAISRTstaI0F65z5jXu0N46he4NZBZ6WfWk96sgJLpvvT2RrcS-xO0hh1EvFzwRy6VbJduS4ruy6JYed3q5wUxhQz8NAeUe2M3V1pVOdebhqoA5Ko-m3kjQ5x?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall reputation)

- Very widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Excellent audit trails and document tracking.
- Extensive integrations with business software.
- Good for growing businesses with more complex workflows.

Website: [DocuSign UK](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for proposals and sales)

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signature collection and tracking in one system.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Signable**

(Best UK-focused option)

- UK-based electronic signature provider.
- Straightforward contract signing.
- Account-based pricing and pay-as-you-go options.
- Particularly interesting for smaller businesses sending fewer documents.

Website: [Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Logo Wordmark PNG Vector - BrandLogo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/95na-wLQUN9p7GmfVbVlsMH9WIm3-bHOmsuOzR4w7FH_LNHajHgaUKajbYSFfuQalq9gsQjPtmcFPYYjJQoXKBtI8uyMeQC8oBjmdwkaHvf0cQn2ZgYIR22CA9JGfELZMa-MGbcgzYfhWePcbsbIj2Mlr0RTRu05Ww7rIP3mtZmaOkamqppjBubOBDVYwJ7W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent for PDF-heavy businesses.
- Strong document editing capabilities.
- Works well with Microsoft 365 and Adobe tools.
- Useful if you already pay for Adobe Acrobat.

Website: [Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/uk/acrobat/business/sign.html)

Comparison based on current 2026 product guides and published pricing information. ## Which would I actually choose?

| Your business requirement | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and signatures | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional, widely recognised system | DocuSign |
| Quotes, proposals and contracts | PandaDoc |
| UK-based provider | Signable |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Acrobat Sign |


**One important thing\:** Don't just compare monthly subscription prices. Check how many documents you can send, whether multiple employees can use the account, and whether templates and audit certificates are included. These restrictions can make a seemingly cheap package expensive as your business grows. [www.sortlist.co.uk](https://www.sortlist.co.uk/blog/software/e-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-esign-software-solution-of-2026-compare-docusign-signnow-adobe-sign-and-more/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the best-value option rather than simply the most expensive or well-known one.

**1\. What type of business do you run?**

- Professional services / consultancy
- Construction / trades
- Recruitment / HR
- Property / estate agency
- Sales / marketing
- Other

**2\. What will you mainly use e-signatures for?**

- Customer contracts and agreements
- Employment contracts and staff paperwork
- Quotes and proposals
- General forms and authorisation documents
- A mixture of everything

**3\. Roughly how many documents need signing each month?**

- Fewer than 10
- 10–50
- 50–200
- More than 200

With those answers, I can narrow it down to the best two or three options, including UK pricing and which offers the best value for money.

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
